original.statement: The ETCD provider's tls.caOptional configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.

decision.reason: [ev-ebfb740bf1f8] shows two ways the removed option can be set in the static configuration: the file key providers.etcd.tls.caOptional (YAML or TOML) and the CLI flag --providers.etcd.tls.caOptional. The remediation only says to remove the option. The proposed exposure matches exactly when either of these is set: it is not broader (nothing else is flagged) and not narrower (both documented ways are covered). values-key is the closest leaf this vocabulary has for a static-config file key, and the evidence mentions no other way to set the option.
